title: phyllanthus linearis var. cognatus
intro: Phyllanthus linearis var. cognatus, commonly known as the Small-leaved Phyllanthus, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Phyllanthus linearis var. cognatus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve liver function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, hepatoprotective, and antioxidant effects.
